name: Typhoon OCR V2 (2B and 0.8B)

lineage.base_model: infly/Infinity-Parser2-Flash (2B); the 0.8B sibling is a separate repo
lineage.how_derived: supervised fine-tuning on curated Thai plus public English and Chinese data, then GRPO with a reward that gives zero to outputs hitting the token limit (aimed at repetition loops on photographed pages)

purpose: Raise Thai accuracy of an already strong English/Chinese parser while keeping its English ability; returns layout elements with category, bounding box and text (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag) plus OpenTyphoon Terms and Conditions
license.notes: Card metadata says apache-2.0 while the card text says use is subject to the OpenTyphoon Terms and Conditions (https://opentyphoon.ai/tac); the terms page and any LICENSE file were not read, so the actual conditions are open.

architecture.kind: vision-language, Qwen3.5 2B architecture (24 layers, 18 linear plus 6 full attention, 24-layer vision tower)

variants.notes: Q8_0 2.01, f16 3.78 GB, mmproj f16 0.67 GB; MLX 4/8-bit and bf16 also official

pc-12gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q8_0 plus mmproj (about 2 to 2.7 GB)
pc-12gb.notes: 2 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q8_0 plus mmproj (about 2 to 2.7 GB)
pc-16gb.notes: 2 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q8_0 plus mmproj (about 2 to 2.7 GB)
pc-24gb.notes: 2 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q8_0 plus mmproj (about 2 to 2.7 GB)
pc-32gb.notes: 2 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q8_0 plus mmproj (about 2 to 2.7 GB)
mac-16-24gb.notes: 2 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q8_0 plus mmproj (about 2 to 2.7 GB)
mac-32gb.notes: 2 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q8_0 plus mmproj (about 2 to 2.7 GB)
mac-64gb+.notes: 2 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Images with a long side under 1,600 px must be enlarged to 1,600 px before sending (card).

strengths: Thai pages: +20 points on MDPBench Thai over its base
also answers document questions and extracts key fields as JSON
weaknesses: English and general parsing scores stay at the base model's level, so outside Thai it adds nothing over Infinity-Parser2-Flash
avoid_for: anything where the licence terms are not cleared
soft.maturity: second generation after Typhoon OCR 1.5; 1.6k downloads at check time

tona_fit.reason: Thai-specific gain; for German or English users it is the base parser plus tuning that does not move English benchmarks, and the licence terms are ambiguous. Keep as the Thai-language option if Tona offers regional models.
blockers: no Tona module for the Qwen3.5 VLM path

open_questions: content of the OpenTyphoon Terms and Conditions
